featured_reviews.name: Rouque Nation
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst Cinema in Virar

Absolutely terrible experience at Rockstar Cinema, Virar.

Right from the entrance, there was no proper security. Instead of trained staff, a little girl was casually asking for tickets, which felt completely unprofessional and unsafe.

As soon as we entered the cinema hall area, there was a horrible stench—like a rotten rat had died somewhere. When we informed the staff, instead of fixing the issue, they just sprayed some air freshener, which made it even worse.

I had booked an M Gold ticket, but the seat was broken. I had to adjust uncomfortably throughout the movie because no staff member was willing to help or even bother.

During the National Anthem, there was no sound at all. People just stood up and sat down in silence, completely ruining the experience and showing zero respect for the moment.

The food counter was equally disappointing—nothing was available. No samosa, no water, no cold drinks, no popcorn. The only thing they had was stale nachos with oily mayonnaise, which looked completely inedible.

Overall, a very disappointing and frustrating experience. Poor management, lack of basic facilities, and no concern for customers. Definitely not visiting again.

featured_reviews.name: Vivek More
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited Fun Fiesta Multiplex and had an absolutely wonderful experience! 🎬 The vibrant and energetic atmosphere immediately put me in a great mood. From the moment I walked in, the staff were friendly and efficient, making the whole process of getting tickets and snacks a breeze. The cinema itself was fantastic – comfortable seating, crystal-clear picture quality, and excellent sound truly enhanced the movie-watching experience. I particularly enjoyed the wide selection of refreshments available. It's truly a top-notch entertainment venue that I would enthusiastically recommend to anyone looking for a fun outing with friends or family. I'm already planning my next visit! ✨🍿😊🎉

featured_reviews.name: Prem Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
This movie theatre is located very close to the area, making it a highly convenient option for regular visits. One of the best things about this place is that it feels quite pocket-friendly, especially when compared to some of the bigger multiplex chains. However, it’s always a good idea to compare the pricing and features with PVR before making a final decision, particularly if looking for a more premium movie experience.

The seating arrangement here is surprisingly good for the price point. The regular seats offer decent comfort and support throughout the movie. That said, the sofa seats are not really worth the extra money – they don't add significant value in terms of comfort or luxury, so it's better to stick with the standard seating options.

The staff at this theatre are well-behaved and helpful. Their treatment of visitors is polite and respectful. One standout feature is their on-seat food service, which is quick and makes the experience more enjoyable.

The theatre is located in Nalasopara, making it a great choice for locals. Both the screen quality and sound system exceed expectations for this price range. For a budget-friendly yet satisfying cinematic experience, this theatre is definitely worth considering.

Lot of people were saying that food is very much expensive (that's why many times i avoid eating in theatres, either you have coke and popcorn in theatres or in the same amount you can have complete lunch or dinner in a decent restaurant)

featured_reviews.name: Jeet Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: This multiplex stands out as one of the finest cinema destinations in the entire Mira Bhayandar, Vasai Virar area. The sheer size and quality of the screen elevate every film to a new level, ensuring that each viewing is nothing short of spectacular. The vibrant visuals, coupled with immersive sound, make it a must-visit for any movie enthusiast. I am certain that watching a movie here will be an unforgettable experience, leaving you eager to return for more.

featured_reviews.name: Priya Dutta
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Fun Fiesta Mall Theatre offers a mixed experience – not outstanding, but not too bad either. It’s the kind of place you might visit once in a while, especially if you're nearby.
One of the better aspects is the top floor of the mall, where the theatre is located. The ambience here is surprisingly good, with several spots that are great for clicking pictures. If you're looking for a casual hangout with friends or family, the top floor makes for a nice setting.

Overall, Fun Fiesta Mall Theatre isn't the best in town, but it’s not the worst either. If you're nearby and looking for a quick movie plan with some chill vibes, it’s worth considering.

featured_reviews.name: CS Rahul Taori
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited MovieMax Mira Road, and overall it was a good experience, especially considering its proximity to my residence.
The biggest advantage of this theatre is its location and convenience — very easy to access if you stay nearby, making it a go-to option for quick movie plans without much travel hassle.
Talking about the theatre itself, the seating, screen quality, and sound system are quite decent. It may not be ultra-premium, but it delivers a comfortable and enjoyable movie experience.
One major downside, however, is the food and beverages. The pricing is quite high compared to the quality and quantity offered. Honestly, it doesn’t feel worth the money, and this is something they really need to improve.
On the positive side, ticket prices are affordable, which balances out the experience to some extent and makes it a budget-friendly entertainment option.
Final Verdict:
A convenient and reliable theatre for regular movie outings, but avoid spending much on food inside.
Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5)

featured_reviews.name: Pankaj Powermax
featured_reviews.review_text:
INOX at Thakur Mall in Dahisar is a popular entertainment hub for residents in the Dahisar and Mira Road areas. Located on the 3rd floor of the mall, it is known for being a well-maintained multiplex that offers a premium cinematic experience at relatively competitive prices compared to other major malls in Mumbai.
Screens: The multiplex typically operates 4 screens, featuring both 2D and 3D projection technology.
​Seating: Options range from standard comfortable seating to luxury recliners (Gold Class) for a more relaxed experience.
​Audio/Visual: Equipped with high-quality sound systems, including Dolby Atmos in select halls, and large screens with high-definition picture quality.
​Accessibility: The cinema is equipped with wheelchair facilities and elevator access.
Refreshments: There is a dedicated F&B counter inside INOX serving classic movie snacks like popcorn, nachos, and sandwiches.
​Food Court: Thakur Mall itself has a multi-cuisine food court on the lower floors, offering a wider variety of dining options after the movie.
​Gaming Zone: There is a gaming area located within the mall, making it a good spot for families and children.
If you're visiting on a weekend, it's advisable to book tickets in advance via apps like BookMyShow, as it is a major landmark and can get quite crowded for blockbuster releases.
Safety system is very nice handle nicely .

featured_reviews.name: Sunny Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: INOX Thakur Mall - Mira Road really impressed me! 🤩 The atmosphere was absolutely fantastic, and I had such a wonderful time. The staff was super friendly and made my visit extra special. 😊 I particularly loved the comfortable seating and the crystal-clear screen. 🎬 The snack bar had some delicious options too! 🍿😋 I'm definitely planning another trip soon; it's a great spot for a fun outing! 👍 it's just they don't have an Imax screen which is a must at every Inox Cinema 🎥📽️

featured_reviews.name: Keval Somaiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re someone who enjoys ads more than movies, this theatre is absolutely perfect for you.

Showtime? More like “suggested time.” I’ve been here multiple times, and without fail, every single show starts 20–30 minutes late. Honestly, you could walk in 20 minutes after the scheduled time and still comfortably sit through a full ad marathon before the movie even begins.

At this point, missing a scene here is nearly impossible—not because of great service, but because punctuality clearly isn’t part of the experience.

It’s hard to tell whether the staff is just taking it easy or the management has created some magical, impossible turnaround schedule between shows. Either way, the result is the same: frustration.

A 2-hour movie somehow turns into a 3-hour commitment. Impressive… just not in the way you’d want.

Would not recommend if you value your time.

featured_reviews.name: ANIKET PARAB
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely Perfect Movie Theatre. Cleaning very Good.This mall has retail outlets selling the most famous brands from across the world. It has a 4 Screen Multiplex Cinema house. This mall has a parking facility of 400 cars in its basement. There is a Cafeteria as well as Pubs & Restaurants. This mall has national & international brands for apparel, fashion and sports. Also, there are other shops selling different types of merchandise. However, there was nothing much to look around. Had roamed around in the mall as a college student.
